input: Scheduled: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (standing ventures brief)
errors: First preflight failed check_hidden_unicode: a literal U+FEFF in the XMP packet header string (the Python edit turned the escape into the character); written as \uFEFF.
Playwright setInputFiles refuses files from several directories ('Multiple directories are not supported'); hard-linked the samples into one folder.

doc_friction.issue: photo-editing's buildable items are all noise-read tuning sweeps; the product has no browser surface a photographer can try, which the row never names. Took a product slice inside the same flagship instead.
`python3 platform/ci/pyenv.py pillow` returned the system python3 whose Pillow cannot import _imaging; a plain venv with pip install pillow worked.

deviations.why: Start here pointed at photo-editing's second item (more noise-read sweeps that four recent sessions judged spent). Stayed on the flagship but built its first no-install user surface: a browser culler.
deviations.did: site/cull.html + site/rawpreview.mjs, eval on 65 public raws, landing link, llms.txt, post
deviations.result: preview found in 61 of 65 files, all 61 decode; page reads 65 files in ~5 s in Chromium

writeups: ventures/photo-editing/README.md (Cull raw files in the browser)
notes: Checks run here: node --test site/rawpreview.test.mjs site/usage.test.mjs (19 pass); eval/cull-page-previews.mjs on metadata-extractor-images (61/65 previews), eval/cull-page-previews-decode.py (decoded 61, failed 0); Playwright Chromium run of cull.html on all 65 files incl. keys, loupe, zoom, sidecar ZIP, CSV, 390px viewport (no overflow, no page errors); venture-preflight (see PR).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a senior front-end dev building a multi-format raw preview parser, keyboard culling UI and XMP export with a 65-file check

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
